.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Delivery profile: shaped reward behind two zero-weight gates and a functional floor)
evidence: Source: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the template (diff empty): [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2; [floors] functional=0.05. task/tests/test.sh and tests/tools/score.py are also identical to the template. Gates carry no reward mass: score.py:46 computes weighted = sum(w*scores[k] for k in weights) only over [weights]; gate dimensions enter only via gates_passed (score.py:41, scores[k] > 0.0). The per-criterion 'weight = 1.0' at gates/{render,constraints}/judge.toml:24 sits under aggregation='all_pass' (template has the same) and has no dimension weight effect; no [judge] block carries a weight. Gates apply before shaping: test.sh:212-222 rm -rf scored, runs the gates suite (1500 s), then score.py; exit 1 (real gate failure) exits before run_suite scored (test.sh:224), exit >=2 writes the plain zero; a gates-suite timeout/nonzero exit leaves the zero record written by write_zero_reward at test.sh:60. score.py:42-48: scored_ran requires gates_passed, reward = 0.0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed. Floor: score.py:47 floors_passed needs scores['functional'] > 0.05. Functional has 16 binary criteria, total weight 33.0 (min 1.5, max 4.0), so an app passing gates but zero functional criteria, or only one 1.5-weight criterion (1.5/33 = 0.0455), gets reward 0 regardless of polish/visual. Scripted simulation of the frozen score.py on synthetic suite outputs (scratchpad copy, python -I): gate render=0 with perfect scored -> exit 1, reward 0.0000; gates pass, no scored output -> reward 0.0000; functional 0.04545 with polish=visual=1 -> reward 0.0000 (weighted 0.4273 recorded but floors_passed 0); functional 0 with polish=visual=1 -> 0.0000; functional 0.0606 -> 0.4364; all 1 -> 1.0000; missing constraints key -> exit 2 (test.sh writes plain zero). Workbook internal annotation ('passing only the cheap gates earns little') holds: gates-only earns 0. Residual risk (why risk=true): no configured RewardKit/judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'), so the real gates/reward.json key names (render/constraints) and the end-to-end gate-failure path are not measured; only template-identical source plus my scripted score.py simulation. Also, by template policy, a thin app that passes the gates and one >=2.0 criterion (e.g. persistence, which 'grades only durability' at functional/judge.toml:335) clears the 0.05 floor (2/33 = 0.0606) and can then collect feature-limited polish/visual credit (rough ceiling ~0.2 since timer_label, hold_mark, retention_marks, transcript_page need real features); the floor value is template-controlled and cannot be changed here, so this is recorded as a ranking concern for rows 42/44, not a defect of this row.
